description: European Central Bank euro reference rates (published once per working day around 16:00 CET): the rate for one currency against the euro, and an optional conversion of an amount between two of the listed currencies. Rates are the ECB's daily reference, not a live market quote; the list has about 30 currencies. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

from.description: Currency code (EUR or one of the ECB list)

to.description: Currency code (EUR or one of the ECB list); default USD
